title: Homelab Server
description: A shared mini PC turned homelab to host multiple programs serving mutiple cuncurrent users.
highlights: Provisioned and self-hosted 3+ concurrent programs running through Docker on a Linux OS mini-PC.
Streamed media to 4 concurrent clients by hosting an open-source media server backed by NAS storage.
Eliminated server's attack surface from 3+ open ports to 0 via a VPN gateway, validated with open-source scanning tools.

title: Fake Image Generator
description: A fake image generator using Generartive Adversarial Networks. From random noise pixels to something that looks like a face...thanks to my limited 1660Ti GPU :).
highlights: Developed a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) in Python with TensorFlow to generate fake images.
Processed 10k+ image files through a custom Data Loader module built in Python with OpenCV.
Improved FID score by 25% through introducing a progressive-growing training technique avaoiding model collapse.

title: UNSW Timetable Planner
description: Developed a class mangement web app, as member of UNSW Development Society, to be in sync with UNSW class offerings. Glad to know its being used by 200+ students actively to plan ther studies for the term.
highlights: Engineered data storage and retrieval for 200+ students by building REST API endpoints in Python with Flask.
Delivered preference-optimised calendars to students by formalizing Linear Programming algorithms in Python.
Integrated E2E testing and observability packages in React with Typescript, increasing test coverage by 40%.

title: COVID-19 Tracker App
description: A React Native mobile app for monitoring global COVID-19 case data. Can search for countries, save them to a personal watchlist, and view historical trends. Powered by JHU dataset.
highlights: Tracked daily COVID-19 data across 90+ countries through a cross-platform React Native mobile app.
Built interactive components and charts to make the trends easy to spot, backed by local storage.
Improved user experience by implementing data caching for a smoother, more responsive interface.
